attchmntText: Biocon Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Biocon Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 04, 2026. The company reported consolidated operating revenues of INR8,725 crores for the first half of FY27, reflecting a 6% year-on-year growth. EBITDA stood at INR1,767 crores with a margin of 20%. Net profit before exceptionals was INR44 crores for the quarter. Biosimilars revenue reached INR2,809 crores. attchmntText: Neueon Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Amendment to AOA/MOA of the company.
voiceSummary: Neueon Corporation Limited has informed the stock exchanges that its members approved alterations to the Articles of Association via Special Resolution through postal ballot on Thursday 29th October 2026. The Registrar of Companies, Central Processing Centre, approved the changes on 11th Nov 2026. The amendment substitutes existing Article 22(i) to allow the Board of Directors to make one, two, or multiple calls on shareholders for unpaid share amounts. This provides flexibility to raise unpaid share capital in phases based on funding needs and cash flow. No call is payable less than 15 days from the date fixed for payment of the last preceding call. The amended Articles are available on the company website at www.neueon.in.

voiceSummary: Gujarat Energy Limited disclosed the transcript of its Q2 FY 27 earnings conference call held on 6th November 2026. attchmntText: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited has informed the Exchange about POWERGRID declared as successful bidder under TBCB
sm_name: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited
voiceSummary: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited has been declared the successful bidder under Tariff Based Competitive Bidding to establish an Intra-State Transmission System. The project involves building a 3X500MVA 400/220kV sub-station at Humnabad in Bidar District, Karnataka, along with associated transmission lines on a Build, Own, Operate and Transfer basis. The quoted Annual Transmission Charges are Rs. 243.34 Crore. The company received the Letter of Intent dated 10th November, 2026 on 11th November, 2026. This win marks the eleventh transmission system project secured by Power Grid under TBCB in FY 2026-27. The cumulative Annual Transmission Charges for these projects amount to Rs. 8,106.97 Crore.

attchmntText: Rain Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Management Commentary on Un-Audited Financial Results of the Company (Standalone, Consolidated and Segment) for the Third Quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Rain Industries Limited filed a notice with BSE and NSE regarding the Management Commentary on Un-Audited Financial Results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. The filing includes an audio link and transcript of the Q&A session. Managing Director Jagan Reddy Nellore, Vice Chairman Gerard Sweeney, and CFO T. Srinivasa Rao participated. Carbon segment net revenue increased by about 22 percent year-on-year in the third quarter to 39.8 billion Rupees. Carbon Adjusted EBITDA eased to 7.4 billion Rupees, a margin of about 19 percent, from 8.1 billion Rupees and 22 percent in the second quarter. Capacity utilisation across the Carbon segment averaged 69 percent during the first nine months of 2026. The restart of the idled kiln at Lake Charles in the United States is targeted for December 2026.

attchmntText: EIH Associated Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
voiceSummary: EIH Associated Hotels Limited has approved an investment of up to 26% in the paid-up capital of M/s Avaada Indsolar Private Limited. This stake corresponds to the company's ownership in a 1 MWac or 1.3 MWdc solar power plant. The move complies with the Electricity Act, 2003, which mandates captive users hold at least 26% equity in the special purpose vehicle. The transaction aims to secure dedicated renewable electricity for hotel operations. Completion is expected by March 2027. Avaada Indsolar Private Limited was incorporated on 29th June 2021. It is not a related party transaction.

voiceSummary: DCW Limited filed an update on pending litigation regarding Writ Appeal WA(MD) 1436/2025, where the Government of Tamil Nadu challenged a Madras High Court Madurai Bench order dated February 26, 2024. The High Court dismissed the appeal on November 03, 2026, ruling that the government could not resume the lands and that the company would suffer detriment if the promise to allot land was broken. The court held that the ingredients of proprietary estoppel were fulfilled and found no merit in the government's claim. The order was uploaded to the court website on November 10, 2026. The company remains in possession of the lands pending final disposal.

attchmntText: Protean eGov Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Press Release titled 'Yubi and Protean eGov Technologies join forces to integrate India s trusted digital rails into the credit lifecycle'.
voiceSummary: Protean eGov Technologies Limited filed a press release regarding a collaboration with Yubi to integrate digital identity and data capabilities into India's credit lifecycle. The partnership aims to enable faster customer onboarding, improved underwriting, and a seamless digital experience for lenders and borrowers. Protean will provide trusted identity, verification, and data services, while Yubi contributes its AI-powered lending infrastructure. The initiative targets reducing friction in loan processing through verified identity checks, consent-based data sharing, and digital documentation. This move seeks to address the formal MSME credit gap and expand credit accessibility for first-time borrowers and small businesses. The collaboration operates within India's regulatory and data protection frameworks.

voiceSummary: Intellect Design Arena Limited announces the launch of Xponent Portfolio Navigator by its Insurtech unit, IntellectAI. voiceSummary: Jyoti Structures Limited announces the progressive release of bank guarantees and letters of credit by its lenders. The company aims to pursue new opportunities in the power transmission and infrastructure sectors. The press release was issued on November 11, 2026.

voiceSummary: Aegis Logistics Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 03, 2026. attchmntText: HCL Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Release-  HCLTech and PTC collaborate to accelerate semiconductor product lifecycle management '.
voiceSummary: HCL Technologies Ltd. has announced a collaboration with PTC to accelerate semiconductor product lifecycle management. The partnership involves launching a pre-configured semiconductor Product Lifecycle Management solution built on the PTC Windchill platform. This solution aims to streamline product development, strengthen quality and compliance, and reduce operational complexity. It connects people, processes, and data across the semiconductor lifecycle, including IP management, new product introduction, supplier collaboration, and regulatory compliance. The solution integrates with existing business, manufacturing, and design systems for end-to-end visibility. HCLTech and PTC stated that the collaboration helps customers modernize product development and management at scale. The announcement was filed with the BSE and NSE on November 10, 2026.

voiceSummary: Jindal Steel and Power Limited received an order from the Additional Commissioner of CGST and Central Excise, Rourkela Commissionerate, on November 10, 2026. The order relates to alleged excess Input Tax Credit claimed and utilized beyond what was reported in GSTR-2A. The company is evaluating the order and may file an appeal. The alleged excess Input Tax Credit amounts to INR 8,41,20,475 and was utilized between June 2020 and March 2022. voiceSummary: JSW Dulux Limited filed a transcript of its group investor call held on 4th November 2026 regarding financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The Department directed Punjab National Bank to encash Rs. 9,72,222 against Reliance Telecom Limited for non-litigated Spectrum Usage Charges dues for Q1 of FY 2026-27. The Department also directed State Bank of India to encash Rs. 65,602 against Reliance Communications Limited for dues in Uttarakhand, Jammu & Kashmir, and Mumbai circles. The total amount sought for encashment is Rs. 26,62,824. The company is examining the financial and legal implications of these demands. This action is part of the ongoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process managed by Resolution Professional Mr. Anish Niranjan Nanavaty.

attchmntText: Dredging Corporation of India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 10, 2026, titled "DCIL Delivers Remarkable Strong Q2 Profitability Turnaround; EBITDA Rises 58.58% Year-on-Year".
voiceSummary: Dredging Corporation of India Limited filed a press release regarding its financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. The company reported a Profit After Tax of 7.31 crore, compared to a loss of 34.17 crore in the previous year. EBITDA rose 58.58% year-on-year to 41.69 crore. Income from own-dredger operations increased 23.08% to 198.66 crore. Total revenue for the quarter was 211.83 crore. For the half-year ended 30 September 2026, PAT improved to 18.54 crore from a loss of 57.51 crore. The Board approved revised estimated useful lives and residual values for eligible dredgers with effect from 4 August 2026. This resulted in reduced depreciation and finance costs for the period. The announcement was submitted to the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange of India on 10 November 2026.

attchmntText: Jubilant Pharmova Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 10, 2026, titled "Jubilant Therapeutics Announces Oral Presentation of Preliminary Phase 1 Clinical Data for JBI-802, a First-in-Class Oral Dual LSD1/HDAC6 Inhibitor, in Essential Thrombocythemia and Related Myeloproliferative Neoplasms at the 68th ASH Annual Meeting".
voiceSummary: Jubilant Pharmova submitted a press release regarding its subsidiary, Jubilant Therapeutics. The release announces the oral presentation of preliminary Phase 1 clinical data for JBI-802 at the 68th ASH Annual Meeting. JBI-802 is a first-in-class oral dual LSD1/HDAC6 inhibitor. The data covers patients with essential thrombocythemia and related myeloproliferative neoplasms. Key findings show rapid platelet reductions and durable hematologic control. The presentation is scheduled for December 14, 2026. The company will host a corporate event on the same date. The press release was filed on November 10, 2026.

voiceSummary: Suyog Telematics Limited filed a transcript of its post-earnings conference call for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, with the BSE and NSE. The call was held on November 5, 2026. The company reported total revenue of INR 717 million and EBITDA of INR 431 million. Net profit stood at INR 153 million with an EPS of 13.09. Vodafone Idea contributed 30% to revenue, Bharti Airtel 48.5%, Jio 19.5%, and BSNL 1.1%. The company holds 6,263 unit towers with 7,674 tenancies. Management stated that billing for Vodafone Idea sites has commenced. BSNL billing faces delays due to integration issues, and the company is not investing further in BSNL until confirmed integration commitments are received. attchmntText: BLS International Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: BLS International Services Limited filed a transcript of its earnings call held on November 04, 2026, discussing performance for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026. For Q2, consolidated revenue reached INR 973 crores, a 32% increase year-on-year. EBITDA grew 17% to INR 248 crores with a margin of 25.5%. Profit after tax was INR 403 crores for the first half, up 10%. The Visa and Consular Services segment reported revenue of INR 510 crores, up 11%, while the Digital Services segment revenue rose 66% to INR 463 crores. The company processed over 500 million applications globally. Net cash stood at INR 1,556 crores as of September 30, 2026. ICRA rated the company AA- for long-term and A1+ for short-term debt. Management expects net revenue per application to grow by 5% to 6% annually.

attchmntText: MMTC Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: MMTC Limited announced the Board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 10th November 2026. The independent auditor issued a qualified conclusion on the standalone results. The qualification relates to the Anglo Coal matter. The company estimates a remaining liability of Rs. 170.58 crore. A provision of Rs. 87.76 crore is recorded. The remaining Rs. 82.82 crore is treated as a contingent liability. The auditor noted a departure from Indian Accounting Standard 37. The Audit Committee could not review the results due to non-appointment of Independent Directors. The Board approved the statement without Audit Committee review. The company reported a profit before tax of Rs. 10.96 crore for the quarter ended 30th September 2026.

The order book stood at approximately INR2,000 crores as of September 2026. The Board proposed increasing borrowing authorization from INR500 crores to INR1,000 crores, subject to shareholder approval. attchmntText: Submission of Monitoring Agency Report for quarter ended 30-06-2026
voiceSummary: Simplex Infrastructures Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 regarding the preferential issue of equity shares and convertible warrants aggregating Rs. 423.69 crore. Unutilized funds are held in fixed deposits with Punjab National Bank.

attchmntText: BLS E-Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript

attchmntText: Standard Engineering Technology Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Standard Engineering Technology Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 05, 2026. The company reported total revenue of INR296.6 crores for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, a 62.3% year-on-year increase. attchmntText: Huhtamaki India Limited has informed the Exchange about Appointment of  Mr.Leyton Bright as Vice President   Operations and Supply Chain of the company w.e.f .November 10, 2026

This intimation is filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. Mr. Bright previously served as General Manager at Huhtamaki UAE and Egypt starting in January 2023, overseeing sites with revenues exceeding €170 million. Prior to that, he worked with Amcor for 19 years across Australia, the Philippines, Indonesia, and the broader Asia Pacific region. He held senior roles in supply chain and operations leadership, including country General Manager positions. The company has submitted the required details to BSE and NSE. Akanksha Kandoi, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the intimation on behalf of the company.

voiceSummary: BLS International Services Limited intimates that Mr. Sarthak Behuria, DIN 03290288, ceases to hold office as an Independent Director with effect from the close of business hours on November 10, 2026. This cessation follows the completion of his second term of five consecutive years, which commenced on November 11, 2021. Mr. Behuria was reappointed by members in a meeting held on September 24, 2021. Consequently, his membership in various Board committees has ceased. The composition of the Audit Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, and Risk Management Committee is updated effective November 11, 2026. Mr. Atul Seksaria, Mr. Nikhil Gupta, Mrs. Dr. Savita, Mr. Ram Sharan Prasad Sinha, Mr. Manoj Joshi, and Mr. Shikhar Aggarwal are listed as members in the respective committees post-cessation. The Company expresses gratitude for Mr. Behuria's guidance and expertise during his tenure.

attchmntText: Hirect Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Hirect Limited filed an investor presentation regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The presentation is available on the company website and will be used for an earnings conference call. The company highlighted its evolution into a technology-led systems provider for railway and industrial sectors. Key developments include the acquisition of Elventive France in 2025-26 to establish a European manufacturing footprint for EMS, robotics, and power electronics. Hirect launched commercial production of specialized copper conductors for transformer applications, securing orders from private customers. The company received approvals from Indian Railways for deploying these conductors in traction transformers. The firm operates two manufacturing plants in Nashik and maintains R&D centers in Mumbai and Hyderabad. Leadership includes Chairman and Managing Director Suramya Nevatia and Chief Financial Officer Anil Kumar Nemani.

attchmntText: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
sm_name: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited
voiceSummary: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited filed a transcript of the Analysts’ and Institutional Investors’ Meet held on 03rd November, 2026, with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited. The meeting discussed performance for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. Chairman and Managing Director Vamsi Rama Mohan Burra reported fixed assets of ₹3.29 lakh crore and a market cap of ₹2.42 lakh crore. Capital expenditure guidance was raised to ₹40,000 crore, with capitalization expected between ₹25,000 crore and ₹30,000 crore. The order pipeline stands at ₹2.20 lakh crore, including ₹1.95 lakh crore under TBCB. The company commissioned 981 circuit kilometres of transmission lines and 14,600 MVA transformation capacity in Q2. Revenue collections remain robust with receivable dues at 10.54 days.

attchmntText: Dhoot Transmission Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Dhoot Transmission Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY2026-27 earnings conference call with the NSE and BSE. The call was held on November 3, 2026. The company reported a 60% year-on-year revenue growth. EV revenue grew 108%, contributing 31% of total sales. Organic adjusted EBITDA margins remained at 15.2%. Pre-exceptional PAT was Rs. 162 crores. Net cash and bank balances stood at Rs. 900 crores. The company revised its annual growth guidance to more than 40%. CAPEX guidance for the year was increased to around Rs. 750 crores. Five new plants are planned for the next 12 months. Battery and electronics CAPEX is estimated at Rs. 150 to Rs. 200 crores.

attchmntText: IFB Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: IFB Industries Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call to BSE and NSE. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, revenue was INR1,512 crores, up 14.04% from INR1,327 crores. PBDIT declined 11.3% to INR90.92 crores due to higher material costs and adverse forex impacts. PBT was INR53.86 crores, and PAT was INR39.56 crores. Year-to-date revenue stood at INR3,042 crores, up 15.34%, with PAT at INR77.62 crores. The Engineering division reported growth driven by fine blanking and stamping, with a business mix of 50% two-wheelers, 40% four-wheelers, and 10% electrical and three-wheelers. A new EV manufacturing facility in Gujarat is under construction, expected to commence operations by September or October 2027. The Steel division increased annealing capacity to 2,800 tons per month, with a customer base split 60% internal and 40% external.

attchmntText: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 10, 2026, titled "Press release in respect of Unaudited (Standalone and Consolidated) Financial Results of theCompany for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited disclosed unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Total income for the half year was 1893.09 million, up 24 percent year on year. EBITDA stood at 678.47 million, a 37 percent increase. Profit after tax reached 277.96 million, reflecting a 54 percent growth. Earnings per share were 5.38. For the second quarter, profit after tax grew 69 percent to 149.50 million. EBITDA rose 45 percent to 363.17 million. The company opened five new diagnostic centres. Suraksha Genomics continues to build its presence. The announcement was made on November 10, 2026.

attchmntText: Emami Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Emami Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 5th November 2026. Consolidated revenue grew by 36% to INR1,088 crores. Domestic sales rose by 49% with volume growth of 43%. EBITDA increased by 25% to INR222 crores. Profit before tax grew by 29% to INR194 crores. Profit after tax was INR144 crores, down by 3%. The Board approved an interim dividend of INR5 per share. The company completed a share buyback worth INR281 crores. International revenue declined by 2% due to disruptions in Nepal and Iraq. Excluding these markets, international business grew by 6%. Gross margins moderated by 520 basis points due to input cost inflation. Strategic investments contributed approximately 26% of domestic business.

attchmntText: Electronics Mart India Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Electronics Mart India Limited disclosed the transcript of its earnings conference call for the second quarter and first half year ended 30th September 2026, held on 05th November 2026. For H1 FY2027, revenue grew 30% to INR4,319 crores, EBITDA nearly doubled to INR369 crores with an 8.6% margin, and PAT grew more than 4x to INR161 crores. Q2 FY2027 revenue rose 19% to INR1,900 crores, with EBITDA at INR131 crores and PAT at INR40 crores. The company operates 229 stores across 102 cities. Management expects festive season demand to be strong and plans to enter West Bengal with four to five stores by mid-November. Working capital days stood at 61 as of 30th September 2026.

attchmntText: SIGMA ADVANCED SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding Postal Ballot Notice   Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Sigma Advanced Systems Limited has issued a Postal Ballot Notice seeking shareholder approval for eight agenda items. The proposals include enhancing overall borrowing limits to Rs. 2500 crores, creating security on assets up to Rs. 2500 crores, and increasing limits for loans, investments, and guarantees under Section 186 to Rs. 4000 crores. The notice also seeks approval for appointing Mr. Galla Jayadev and Ms. Urkavalan Jeya Santhi as Independent Directors for five years effective November 06, 2026. Additionally, it proposes changing Mr. Sunil Kumar Kalidindi's designation from Whole Time Director to Managing Director, and Mr. Kartheek Raju Chintalapati's from Non-Executive Director to Whole-Time Director. The company also seeks approval to raise funds through various methods. The e-voting period runs from November 11, 2026, to December 10, 2026.

attchmntText: COSMO FIRST LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Cosmo First Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 04, 2026. Consolidated sales for the September 2026 quarter reached Rs. 1,388 crore, a 51% year-on-year increase. EBITDA grew 38% to Rs. 177 crore, including a Rs. 24.8 crore write-back from US customs duty refunds and a Rs. 7 crore inventory loss. Excluding these items, EBITDA was Rs. 159 crore. The company adopted the new tax regime for FY27, expecting an effective tax rate between -6% and -7%. Net debt reduced to Rs. 1,057 crore. Management highlighted strong growth in specialty chemicals, rigid packaging, and consumer verticals Zigly and Cosmo Consumer. Capacity additions for specialty films and barrier sheets are planned for the second half of FY27. Renewable power is expected to meet two-thirds of power requirements by next year, saving Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore annually.

attchmntText: India Pesticides Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: India Pesticides Limited filed the transcript of the earnings call for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026. The call was held on 05th November 2026. For H1 FY27, revenue was INR 487 crores, down 15.9% year-on-year. EBITDA was INR 73 crores with a margin of 14.9%. Profit after tax was INR 41 crores. Export revenue for H1 FY27 was INR 177 crores. The company has received export orders for the coming quarter. Net cash on a consolidated basis increased to INR 36 crores as on 30th September 2026.

attchmntText: Websol Energy System Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Websol Energy System Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings call held on 5th November 2026. The company reported half-year revenue of INR 734 crores and net profit of INR 80 crores for the period ended 30th September 2026. Websol became debt-free in August 2026 after repaying IREDA debt. Solar cell utilization stood at 91 percent, with module utilization at 68 percent. The order book reached INR 1,280 crores. The Board approved a 4 gigawatt integrated facility in West Bengal on 54.20 acres, planned in two phases. Phase one costs INR 1,350 crores. The company is converting its MonoPERC line to TOPCon technology. The Board also approved entering EPC, independent power production, and energy trading sectors. It approved subscribing to 40 percent of Bright Earth Cell Private Limited for energy trading. Vinay was appointed CEO of Websol Renewables. Trial runs for the new facility are targeted for the third quarter of the next financial year.

attchmntText: Quadrant Future Tek Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release regarding launch of  Zone Connect by The Park , Mathura'.
voiceSummary: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited announced the launch of Zone Connect by The Park Mathura on November 10, 2026. attchmntText: Container Corporation Of India Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Container Corporation of India Limited released the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 03.11.2026. The company reported highest ever physical performance with total handling volume of 1,448,379 TEUs. Operating turnover reached INR2,373 crores and total income was INR2,466 crores. Standalone profit before tax was INR462 crores. The company announced a dividend of INR1.9 per share. Total dividend for the first half is INR3.5 per share. EBITDA margin stood at 25.79%. Capex for the quarter was INR299.75 crores. Total half year capex increased to INR418.05 crores. Management cited geopolitical turbulence in the Gulf as a challenge. However, domestic and EXIM segments showed resilience. Nepal business volume increased by 138%. Bulk cement tank container volume reported about 12,000 TEUs. Management stated they would review guidance in December.

The company entered a 50:50 joint venture with DCX Chrome SAS, France, for a high-purity Chromium Metal facility. Domestic and export sales contributed 58% and 42%, respectively. ICRA assigned an A Stable rating to long-term banking facilities. Consolidated debt-to-equity was 0.67x.

attchmntText: GPT Infraprojects Limited has informed the Exchange about Alcon Builders & Engineers Private Limited (WOS) of GPT Infraprojects Limited for being declared as L1 (Lowest First) in order valued at Rs. 103.58 Crore.

The contract involves the design, programming, installation, supply, testing, and commissioning of an Electronic Interlocking System conforming to RDSO Specification No. RDSO/SPN/192/2019. Work includes indoor and outdoor activities at multiple stations in the Varanasi Division of N.E. Railway. attchmntText: The Hi-Tech Gears Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: The Hi-Tech Gears Limited filed an earnings presentation for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The firm supplies components to automotive original equipment manufacturers including Hero MotoCorp, Mahindra, and Daimler.

attchmntText: Kalyani Forge Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Kalyani Forge Limited filed the transcript of its Analyst and Investor Conference Call held on November 06, 2026, pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The call discussed financial performance for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Managing Director Viraj G. Kalyani announced a board-approved Rs. 45 crore funding plan comprising Rs. 10 crore equity, Rs. 20 crore debt, and up to Rs. 20 crore from non-core asset and inventory monetization. First half of FY27 Profit Before Tax rose 118% year-on-year to Rs. 9.39 crore, while Profit After Tax increased 86% to Rs. 6.64 crore. Second quarter EBITDA margin stood at 14.2%, marking the fourth consecutive quarter above this threshold. Truck segment sales surged 75% year-on-year to Rs. 23.3 crore, representing 43% of total sales. Revenue declined 18% sequentially to Rs. 54.4 crore due to planned downtime from reconditioning a 2,500-ton press and relocating the driveline machining plant. Receivables increased due to delayed remittances during a banking changeover. The company is normalizing collections and expanding capacity for new engine and wheel hub orders.

attchmntText: Mukka Proteins Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Mukka Proteins Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its Q2 and FY27 unaudited financial results for the period ended 30th September 2026. The company reported an export revenue share of 81.3% for Q2 FY27. It commenced commercial production at its new Al Juba facility in Oman during the quarter. The firm secured US FDA facility registration for its Oman and Mangaluru facilities. Mukka Proteins holds approximately 25 to 30% market share in fish meal and fish oil revenue. The company targets revenue growth from 1,449 crore rupees in FY26 to over 3,000 crore rupees by FY30. It operates 18 owned in-house production facilities in India and Oman. The presentation highlights a strategic shift toward an integrated animal protein and sustainability platform.

attchmntText: Vardhman Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript.
voiceSummary: Vardhman Textiles Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call with the BSE and NSE on 10th November 2026. The call was held on 6th November 2026. Management reported improved yarn business performance driven by higher demand, rising yarn prices, and trading gains from low-cost cotton purchases. Current cotton landed costs are approximately INR65,000 per candy. The fabric business faced challenges due to lower export volumes, tariff uncertainty, and higher input costs. The company expects improved order pipelines following US election results. An open-end yarn project with a capacity of 50 tons per day is expected to be operational in six to seven months. No major capital expenditure plans for the spinning business have been announced for the next two years.

attchmntText: Platinum Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Platinum Industries Limited filed a transcript of its post-earnings conference call held on 05th November, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue from operations of INR 121.3 crores for Q2 FY27, up from INR 98.4 crores in Q2 FY26. Profit after tax for the quarter was INR 7.6 crores. For H1 FY27, consolidated revenue stood at INR 230.20 crores, with profit after tax at INR 18.7 crores. Management highlighted capacity expansion in Palghar and an Egypt facility with increased capacity to 60,000 MTPA. Partial capacity in Egypt is expected by 31st December, 2026. Sales from Platinum Oleo chemicals reached INR 11.4 crores in Q2 FY27. The company noted rising ocean freight costs impacting margins but expects utilization improvements in the second half of FY27.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Trejhara Solutions Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited. The report concerns the utilization of proceeds from a Preferential Issue of Equity Shares and Convertible Warrants totaling Rs 162.17 crore. The issue period was from January 27, 2026, to February 10, 2026. The company has utilized Rs 50.44 crore, primarily for strategic acquisitions. attchmntText: Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY 2026-27 earnings conference call held on November 04, 2026.
